packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry moves as one unit. The sdk, the OTLP exporter and the instrumentation packages are released together and pin each other: the sdk requires opentelemetry-api==X and opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==Y, each instrumentation package requires the same semantic-conventions and opentelemetry-instrumentation==Y, and the exporter requires opentelemetry-proto==X and opentelemetry-sdk~=X. Bumping one without the rest does not resolve. The shared python preset already batches opentelemetry-* but only minor and patch, and together with unrelated libraries (click, requests, feedparser); this rule is applied after the preset's, so it replaces that group with one of its own that includes majors. The dev- branch prefix from the preset's base rule is left alone, so the update still cuts a release.
